tool_config.name: perevod_nightdesk_demo
tool_config.description: Puts the live call through to a person: to the on-call team for an emergency the sortirovka result marked PEREVOD, or to the office when the office is OPEN. Call it WITHOUT announcing anything first — the phone system itself tells the caller they are being connected. If ok is true, say nothing more: a person takes over. If ok is false, say the meaning of soobshchenie (the on-call team has the report and will call back) and continue. Never use it to leave a message. Never for something that is not an emergency when the office is CLOSED. Never promise to stay on the line.

svodka.description: One short English sentence for the person who answers: what and where, e.g. "Water leak from the ceiling at 41 Harbor Row, apartment 4B." No names, no phone numbers, no health details.

yazyk.description: Language of the conversation right now.
